blocks.en:
Winter 2026 Session Payment & Refunds Information

1 Tuition Bill & Tuition Payment

□ 1st round: November 18 (Wed) ~ November 23 (Mon)

□ 2nd round (Final): November 26 (Thu) ~ November 27 (Fri)

※ Bill printing: Log on at mySNU → Academic Affairs → Tuition → Billing Info → Winter/Winter Session

Tuition Bill

2 Tuition Fee

□ Theory courses: 40,500 KRW per credit

□ Practical courses: 45,500 KRW per credit

3 Payment: Bank, Virtual Account and ATM

□ By bank windows: 9:00 AM – 16:00 PM *It may vary depending on the bank branch

□ By virtual account

- Nov. 18 (Wed) 09:00 ~ Nov. 23 (Mon) 17:00 *Weekends are excluded

- Nov. 26 (Thu) 09:00 ~ Nov. 27 (Fri) 17:00

□ ATM transfers

- When you do not have the tuition bill or do not know the virtual account number,

payment through an ATM is also possible.

- Procedures are as follows: public imposts → tuition fee → approval code (Nonghyup

079695 / Shinhan 88105) → input your student ID number (confirm your name and

check the amount) → payment

□ Notes

- Students making payments at banks other than Nonghyup, Shinhan or Woori Bank

will be subject to service charges.

- Separate payment for courses is unavailable.

- After payment for courses, it is not possible to change the course into other

courses. (For the courses which have been canceled by department, students can

change to other courses which provide same amount of credits)
4 Confirmation of Education Expense Payment (the receipt)

□ SMS notification: personal mobile (If you agreed to receive SMS notification)

□ Tuition Bill & Tuition Payment: mySNU → printing the online receipt

5 Announcement of Course Cancellation

□ If the courses you signed up were cancelled, ① get a refund or ② change them

into other courses which provide same amount of credits.

□ Course cancellation announcement after the payment: Dec. 1 (Tue) at the mySNU notice boards.

6 Course Withdrawal and Refund

□ Course Withdrawal

Date Remark note
Fri - Mon,
Dec 11, 2026 – Dec 21, 2026 100% refundable Before class begins

Tue - Fri, 2/3 refundable 1/3 of Class days
Dec 22, 2026 – Jan 1, 2027
Sat - Thu, 1/2 refundable 1/2 of Class days
Jan 2, 2027 – Jan 7, 2027

※ From Jan 8 (Fri), course cancellation and refund is unavailable.

※ The trasfers will reach your bank account after 3 weeks or so of the final day of the course
withdrawal.

□ Course Withdrawal and Refund

- Before class begins (Dec 11 – Dec 21, 2026)
mySNU → Academic affairs → Class/Grade → Class → Course Drop(Summer/Winter

Session) → Save → Submit

- After class begins (Dec 22, 2026 – Jan 7, 2027)
(Need for instructor’s approval) mySNU → Academic affairs → Class/Grade → Class
→ Course Drop(Summer/Winter Session) → Save → Submit → Instructor’s approval
(No need for instructor’s approval) Academic affairs → Class/Grade → Class →
Course Drop(Summer/Winter Session) → Save → Submit
* Enter account number: mySNU → My Info → Modify Personal Info (Your personal bank account number should be written)

blocks.en: 2026 Academic Year Winter Session: Tuition Payment and Refund Guide
blocks.ko: 2026학년도 동계 계절수업 수강료 납부 및 환불 안내

blocks.en: 1 Payment and Bill Printing Periods
□ 1st round: 18 Nov 2026 (Wed) ~ 23 Nov 2026 (Mon)
□ 2nd round (final): 26 Nov 2026 (Thu) ~ 27 Nov 2026 (Fri)
※ How to print your bill: mySNU > Log in > 학사정보 (Academic Information) > 등록 (Registration) > 고지서/내역조회 (Bills/View History) > 계절학기 고지서 (Seasonal Session Bill)
blocks.ko: ※ 고지서 출력 방법: mySNU > 로그인 > 학사정보 > 등록 > 고지서/내역조회 > 계절학기 고지서

blocks.en: mySNU > 학사서비스 (Academic Services) at the bottom of the page > 등록금고지서 출력 (Print Tuition Bill)
2 Tuition (per 1 credit): theory courses KRW 40,500 (40,500원), practical courses KRW 45,500 (45,500원)
3 Payment methods: bank, virtual account, and ATM
blocks.ko: 3 납부 방법: 은행, 가상계좌 및 ATM 납부

blocks.en: □ Payment at any bank counter: weekdays 09:00 ~ 16:00 during the payment period *hours may differ by branch
blocks.ko: □ 전 은행 창구 납부: 납부기간 내 평일 09:00 ~ 16:00 *지점에 따라 일부 상이

blocks.en: □ Payment by virtual account (a bank account number issued only for your payment)
- 18 Nov 2026 (Wed) 09:00 ~ 23 Nov 2026 (Mon) 17:00 (excluding Saturday and Sunday) *On the last payment day (23 Nov), payment closes at 17:00
- 26 Nov 2026 (Thu) 09:00 ~ 27 Nov 2026 (Fri) 17:00 *On the last payment day (27 Nov), payment closes at 17:00
□ Payment at an ATM
- Use this if you do not have your bill or do not know your virtual account number
blocks.ko: - 고지서가 없거나 가상계좌번호를 모르는 경우 활용

blocks.en: - Utility bills > University tuition > Enter the approval code (NongHyup 079695, Shinhan 88105) > Enter your student ID number > Look up (check the student name and amount) > Pay
blocks.ko: - 공과금>대학등록금>승인코드 입력(농협 079695, 신한 88105)>학번 입력>조회(학생 이름, 금액 확인)>납부

blocks.en: □ Notes on payment
- Any transaction fees must be paid by the student
- Paying separately for each course (paying in parts) is not allowed
- After paying tuition, you cannot change courses (however, if a course is cancelled, you may move to another course with the same number of credits and the same fee)
blocks.ko: - 수강료 납부 후에는 교과목 변경 불가(단, 폐강 시 동일학점 동일금액으로 이동 가능)

blocks.en: 4 Payment confirmation
□ SMS notice: sent to your own mobile phone (if you agreed to receive SMS in your personal information settings)
blocks.ko: □ SMS 통지: 본인 핸드폰(개인정보에서 SMS 수신 동의한 경우)

blocks.en: □ Certificate of payment: mySNU > 인터넷증명서 발급 (Online Certificate Issuance)
5 Checking for cancelled courses
□ If a course is cancelled after you have paid, you may move to another course with the same number of credits and the same fee, or request a refund
blocks.ko: □ 납부 후 폐강된 강좌는 동일학점 동일금액의 다른 과목으로 이동하거나 환불 요청

blocks.en: □ Announcement of courses cancelled after payment: 1 Dec 2026 (Tue), on the mySNU notice board 6 Course Withdrawal Periods and Refund Methods
blocks.ko: □ 수납 후 폐강 공고: 2026. 12. 1.(화), mySNU 게시판 6 수강 취소 기간 및 환불 방법

blocks.en: □ Withdrawal periods
Course withdrawal period / Refund amount / Remarks
blocks.ko: 수강 취소 기간 환불 금액 비고

blocks.en: 11 Dec 2026 (Fri) ~ 21 Dec 2026 (Mon) / Full refund of the amount paid / Before classes start
22 Dec 2026 (Tue) ~ 1 Jan 2027 (Fri) / Refund of two-thirds (2/3) of the amount paid / Up to 1/3 of class days
2 Jan 2027 (Sat) ~ 7 Jan 2027 (Thu) / Refund of one-half (1/2) of the amount paid / Up to 1/2 of class days
※ From 8 Jan 2027 (Fri), withdrawal and refunds are not possible. The refund will be deposited about 3 weeks after the application deadline.
blocks.ko: ※ 2027. 1. 8.(금)부터 취소 및 환불 불가하며, 환불금액 입금은 신청마감일 이후 약 3주 정도 소요

blocks.en: □ How to withdraw and get a refund

- Before classes start (until 21 Dec): apply to withdraw from the course and for a tuition refund at mySNU > 학사행정 (Academic Administration) > 계절학기 (Seasonal Session) > 수강신청취소/환불신청 (Course Registration Cancellation/Refund Application)
blocks.ko: - 개강 전(12. 21.까지): mySNU > 학사행정 > 계절학기 > 수강신청취소/환불신청에서 수강신청 취소 및 수강료 반환 신청

blocks.en: - After classes start (from 22 Dec) · (If approval is required) mySNU > 계절학기 수강취소 신청 (Seasonal Session Course Withdrawal Application) > withdrawal is complete after the instructor in charge approves · (If approval is not required) mySNU > apply for seasonal session course withdrawal and refund
blocks.ko: - 개강 이후(12. 22.부터) · (승인필요시) mySNU > 계절학기 수강취소 신청 > 담당교원 승인 후 취소 완료 · (승인생략시) mySNU > 계절학기 수강취소 신청 및 환불 신청

blocks.en: ※ You must register and check a bank account in your own name (required): mySNU > 학사정보 (Academic Information) > 나의정보 (My Information) > 개인정보수정 (Edit Personal Information)
blocks.ko: ※ 학생 본인 명의 계좌 등록 및 확인 (필수) mySNU > 학사정보 > 나의정보 > 개인정보수정

blocks.en: ※ A refund can be made only if you register an account number in your own name (be careful not to register an account in another person's name, such as a family member's)
blocks.ko: ※ 본인 명의의 계좌번호를 등록해야 환불 가능(가족 명의 등 타인 명의의 계좌 등록하지 않도록 유의)

english: This notice gives the tuition payment and refund schedule for the 2026 Academic Year Winter Session (동계 계절수업, winter seasonal classes). Please pay within the payment period.
※ Final course cancellation (if fewer than 20 students have paid): 8 Dec 2026 (Tue)
2. Payment method: Payment at any bank or by virtual account (가상계좌, a bank account number assigned to each student for payment)
Attachment: 2026 Academic Year Winter Session Tuition Payment Guide (Korean/English)
